this_title: Morgan Jay: I Hope My Ex Doesn't See This
introduction: You’ve seen his viral TikTok clips. You’ve seen his YouTube videos. You may have even seen one of his live shows. But Morgan Jay wasn’t always the “autotune comedy guy.” In his debut, self-produced comedy special, an early-career Morgan tackles life’s little pleasures and annoyances in an intimate musical gathering with just a nylon-string guitar as he sings through his deeply relatable personal experiences in and out of love. Whether they be of joy, sadness, and uncontrollable laughter, you’ll find yourself in tears during this slice-of-life style performance.
